WRITE ESSAY · 01 / 37

正式笔试

Formal Written Examinations

作文题目 · 英文原题

Many education systems assess students' learning using formal written examinations. Those kinds of exams are a valid method. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give examples with your own experience.

总论点 · 总体立场

同意正式笔试是有效的评估方式

As far as I am concerned, I am convinced that formal written examinations are a fair and useful way to assess students.

分论点 1

笔试对所有学生公平

formal written examinations are fair and objective.

解释
all students take the same test under the same conditions, so teachers can compare their results fairly.
例子
when students take a written mathematics exam, teachers use the same rules to give marks.
分论点 2

笔试帮助检查知识

written examinations can test students’ knowledge.

解释
students have to answer questions by themselves, which shows what they have learned.
例子
in an English writing test, teachers can see whether students know how to use grammar correctly.

完整作文

In recent years, there has been growing concern about formal written examinations. Some individuals believe that this issue brings important benefits, while others hold different views. As far as I am concerned, I am convinced that formal written examinations are a fair and useful way to assess students.

First of all, from my point of view, formal written examinations are fair and objective. This means that all students take the same test under the same conditions, so teachers can compare their results fairly. For example, when students take a written mathematics exam, teachers use the same rules to give marks. Hence, it is clear that this point is important when considering the issue.

Besides, I also hold another point of view that written examinations can test students’ knowledge. To be more specific, students have to answer questions by themselves, which shows what they have learned. For instance, in an English writing test, teachers can see whether students know how to use grammar correctly. This undoubtedly shows why this issue deserves careful attention.

In conclusion, there is no denying that this topic plays an important role in modern society. Despite some opposing views, much evidence shows that formal written examinations are a fair and useful way to assess students.

In recent years, there has been growing concern about mass media. Some individuals believe that this issue brings important benefits, while others hold different views. As far as I am concerned, I am convinced that mass media has a strong influence on young people’s opinions.

First of all, from my point of view, mass media can help young people learn about important issues. This means that news reports allow students to understand problems in society and the world. For example, when students watch news about air pollution, they can learn why protecting the environment is important. Hence, it is clear that this point is important when considering the issue.

Besides, I also hold another point of view that mass media can sometimes have negative effects on young people. To be more specific, some online news may contain false information, which can influence how teenagers think. For instance, when teenagers believe false stories shared on social media, they may form wrong opinions about other people. This undoubtedly shows why this issue deserves careful attention.

In conclusion, there is no denying that this topic plays an important role in modern society. Despite some opposing views, much evidence shows that mass media has a strong influence on young people’s opinions.
